name: application-comparison-slider
title: Comparison Slider
description: Before/after image comparison slider components with a draggable handle for showcasing visual changes side by side.
useWhen: Before/after image comparison slider components with a draggable handle for showcasing visual changes side by side.
avoidWhen: Avoid comparison slider when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Comparison Slider uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
